h1: Meter Bank Replacement for Apartment Buildings in Broward County
intro: When a meter bank fails, a whole apartment building can go dark at once. Our largest recent job was a ten-meter bank replaced after a vehicle fire, back online within two weeks with the electrical work done in one. We show up whenever you call.

definition.heading: What a meter bank is and why it matters
definition.body: The ganged assembly of meter sockets serving a multi-unit building, one per apartment. Because every unit runs through it, the bank is a shared point of failure, and decades of South Florida heat, humidity, and salt air corrode the metal that carries the load.

symptoms.title: Multiple units lost power at once
symptoms.body: Several apartments went dark together while the neighborhood still has power. The fault is usually at the shared service or the bank, not inside any single unit.

symptoms.title: Rust and corrosion across the bank
symptoms.body: Rust streaks, pitting, or chalky corrosion across the enclosure and sockets. Widespread corrosion means the whole bank is aging out.

symptoms.title: Scorching, heat, or a burning smell
symptoms.body: Connections are arcing under load. On a shared assembly feeding many units, that is a serious fire risk that needs a licensed electrician right away.

symptoms.title: Damaged service after an impact or fire
symptoms.body: A vehicle strike, fire, storm, or vandalism has damaged the assembly. The building may be unsafe and dark until it is properly replaced.

localSections.heading: Aging apartment stock and original service
localSections.body: Much of Broward's rental housing dates to the 1960s through the 1980s and still runs on original service equipment. Metal fatigues, jaws loosen, and connections work loose, and on an apartment building that decline sits above every tenant.

localSections.heading: Heat, humidity, and salt air on a shared assembly
localSections.body: A bank has more positions, connections, and exposed metal than a single socket. Salt air corrodes the enclosure, jaws, and lugs while the cooling load runs most of the year, so equipment here can fail across several positions at once.

guide.title: The complete guide to meter bank replacement for South Florida apartment buildings

sections.heading: A real job: ten meters back online in a week
sections.body: An apartment building lost power for a week after a vehicle fire damaged the meter bank. We took on the ten-meter replacement, coordinated the utility and permit, and finished the electrical work in one week, back online within two. Every situation differs, but that is the scale we handle.

sections.heading: Why meter banks fail on older buildings
sections.body: Corrosion leads, since the assembly lives outdoors and salt air settles into every jaw and lug. Heat is next: corroded connections add resistance, resistance makes heat, and heat speeds corrosion. Add decades of age, and a bank fails broadly rather than at one meter.

sections.heading: How a replacement is planned, with the utility and permit
sections.body: It starts with an assessment of every position and the service. Because the meters belong to the utility, the work runs in order: scheduled disconnect, licensed replacement with climate-rated equipment, inspection, reconnect. We manage the whole chain and keep the outage as short as safety allows.

faqs.question: The whole building lost power. Is that the meter bank?
faqs.answer: Often, yes. If many units went dark at once while the neighborhood still has power, the fault is usually at the shared service or the bank. We confirm where it is and tell you honestly whether it is a targeted repair or a full replacement.

faqs.question: How long will tenants be without power?
faqs.answer: The building is off during the replacement and the utility disconnect and reconnect. We plan that window to be as short as safety allows and walk you through the timing before the work day.

faqs.question: Do you handle the power company and the permit?
faqs.answer: Yes. We coordinate the utility disconnect and reconnect, pull the permit, and pass inspection under our license, so you handle tenants and the owner while we handle the paperwork.

faqs.question: Should I repair one bad meter position or replace the bank?
faqs.answer: If corrosion or heat damage is spread across the bank, replacing one position just moves the problem. We assess the full bank and the service, then give a straight recommendation. If a targeted repair will genuinely hold, we say so.
